label: preparing
what: A community hospitality gathering/feast in the great hall at 18:00 on day 1, with lanterns, two hundred loaves, and a programme whose details are being kept as a surprise. Builder coordinates hall supplies and lighting; innkeeper and freight arranged catering, baker supplied the loaves, and neighbour helped spread the invitation. No evidence the secretary is knowingly helping organize it; the mayor was initially not told the plan, though later invited.
